title: Create standardized online municipal building permit system
description: Build a province-wide standardized online municipal building permit system to make permitting consistent for builders and approval times across cities, while cutting administrative and technology costs for municipalities.
original_quote: Create a standardized, province-wide online municipal building permit system to provide consistency in permitting for builders in every city in the province, and to ensure consistent permit approval times between communities, reducing administration and technology cost burdens on municipalities.

title: Unify provincial enforcement teams into a single agency
description: Merge provincial enforcement teams for gambling, liquor, traffic, transit police, and tobacco into one agency using outcomes-based regulation to cut duplication, improve efficiency, reduce red tape, and target bad actors.
original_quote: Unify our provincial enforcement teams for gambling, liquor, traffic, transit police, and tobacco into a single enforcement agency that uses outcomes-based regulation to reduce duplication, improve efficiency, reduce red tape, and focus on bad actors.

title: Leverage AI to ease administration costs
description: Use emerging AI technology to reduce administrative costs and workloads in key programs that involve reviewing large volumes of non-sensitive data.
original_quote: Leverage emerging AI technology to ease administration costs and burdens in key program areas that require the review of large amounts of non-sensitive data.

title: Keep public service ratios consistent with other provinces
description: Maintain public service ratios in line with other provinces and best practices.
original_quote: Ensure our public service ratios continue to be consistent with other provinces and best practices.

title: Keep debt-to-GDP among the lowest in Canada
description: Ensure BC's debt-to-GDP ratio stays among the lowest in Canada.
original_quote: Ensure our debt-to-GDP remains among the lowest in Canada.

title: Lobby Ottawa to reallocate immigration policy and funding
description: Press the federal government to shift immigration policy and funding to the province, similar to Quebec's arrangement.
original_quote: Lobby Ottawa to reallocate immigration policy and funding to the provincial government similar to the agreement in place in Quebec.

title: Manage public finances sustainably while putting people first
description: Manage public finances sustainably on a path back to balanced budgets while prioritizing people.
original_quote: we are on a path to return BC to balance... managing public finances sustainably while putting people first
